        if m:

    rid = f'rId{(max(rid_nums) if rid_nums else 0) + 1}'

    cnv_ids = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'<p:cNvPr id=\"(\\d+)\"', slide)]
    pic_id = (max(cnv_ids) if cnv_ids else 1) + 1

    pic_xml = f'''<p:pic><p:nvPicPr><p:cNvPr id=\"{pic_id}\" name=\"Landscape frame 00:08\"/><p:cNvPicPr><a:picLocks noChangeAspect=\"1\"/></p:cNvPicPr><p:nvPr/></p:nvPicPr><p:blipFill><a:blip r:embed=\"{rid}\"/><a:stretch><a:fillRect/></a:stretch></p:blipFill><p:spPr><a:xfrm><a:off x=\"0\" y=\"0\"/><a:ext cx=\"9144000\" cy=\"5143500\"/></a:xfrm><a:prstGeom prst=\"rect\"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom><a:ln><a:noFill/></a:ln></p:spPr></p:pic>'''

    rels = rels.replace('</Relationships>', rel_insert + '</Relationships>', 1)

    fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=str(ppt.parent))
    os.close(fd)
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp_path, 'w', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
            for item in zin.infolist():
                data = zin.read(item.filename)
                if item.filename == 'ppt/slides/slide2.xml':
                    data = slide.encode('utf-8')
                elif item.filename == rels_name:
                    data = rels.encode('utf-8')
                zout.writestr(item, data)
            zout.write(img, media_name)
        shutil.move(tmp_path, ppt)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp_path):
            os.remove(tmp_path)

print('updated', ppt)
print('backup', backup)
print('added', media_name, rid)
